## Concept Checklist (Definition of Done)
Please ensure all requirements from `MASTER_PLAN.md` are satisfied:

- [ ] Follows `_template/concept.md` layout and frontmatter exactly.
- [ ] Includes a 30-second summary, failure story, everyday analogy, and clear definition.
- [ ] No em dashes used anywhere in prose or comments.
- [ ] Valid Mermaid diagram included and renders properly.
- [ ] `demo.mjs` runs cleanly on Node LTS with zero external packages (`node demo.mjs`).
- [ ] Side-by-side broken vs fixed code clearly contrasted.
- [ ] Honest trade-offs: includes when NOT to use the concept.
- [ ] Real sources cited (no invented statistics or unverified claims).
- [ ] 3 self-test questions and 2 interview questions included.
- [ ] 5-line cheat sheet included.
- [ ] Ran `node scripts/build-index.mjs` and verified with `node scripts/check-demos.mjs`.
